subject: [PATCH v2 0/5] btrfs: handle -ENOMEM errors in some synchronous dirops without aborting

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: Reviewer Qu Wenruo noted that only two callsites use on-stack memory for the prealloc structure and suggested converting to a heap-based solution. Additionally, they pointed out a potential issue with the lifespan management of btrfs_dir_index_prealloc, suggesting a more straightforward approach using regular heap memory allocation.

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a long-standing issue in the Btrfs file system where memory allocation failures can cause the file system to abort. The patches rework the code to perform memory allocations before critical points, preventing aborts due to ENOMEM errors. This includes changes to directory morphing and orphan handling, with additional tests added to exercise the new behavior. While not all potential cases are covered, this series is designed to work in conjunction with other patches to address remaining issues.
